BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-
41, Community Shopping District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
30-F in the area bound by:

West 127" Street; a line 327.01 feet east of and parallel to South Wentworth
Avenue; West 127" Street; and, a line 174.25 east of an parallel to South
Wentworth Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
